payload.body: JUST IN - UK's HMS Dragon to redeploy to Middle East, ahead of potential role in a future mission, to safeguard shipping in Strait of Hormuz. The HMS Dragon had been deployed to Cyprus to defend RAF bases. Read here: https://www.disclose.tv/id/ugo3wlepz6/ @disclosetv
